title: 26th October - Fourth Trust Meeting
summary: The Fourth Trust Meeting was held on 26th October 2026 from 6.30 pm onwards at Hindu Gymkhana and attended by 17 Office Bearers and Trustees.
description: The Fourth Trust Meeting was held on 26th October 2026 from 6.30 pm onwards at Hindu Gymkhana and attended by 17 Office Bearers and Trustees. The Trust Meeting was hosted by Rtn Suhit Jhaveri.
